description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewaySession class, specifically testing WebSocket connection handling, token management, invocation request handling, and related gateway interactions within the Android environment. It uses Robolectric for Android testing, MockWebServer for simulating server interactions, and coroutines for asynchronous operations.

classes.name: InMemoryDeviceAuthStore
classes.description: An in-memory implementation of DeviceAuthTokenStore used for testing token load, save, and clear operations.

classes.name: NodeHarness
classes.description: A data class encapsulating a GatewaySession, its related job, and device auth store for testing purposes.

classes.name: InvokeScenarioResult
classes.description: A data class holding the details of an invoke request and its resulting parameters after execution.

classes.name: GatewaySessionInvokeTest
classes.description: Test class containing multiple unit tests for GatewaySession behaviors such as connection handling, token management, and invoke request processing.

methods.name: testJson
methods.description: Creates and returns a Json parser instance configured to ignore unknown keys.

methods.name: createNodeHarness
methods.description: Initializes a test harness with a GatewaySession, device auth store, and related coroutine scope for testing.

methods.name: connectNodeSession
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection for the GatewaySession with specified parameters.

methods.name: awaitConnectedOrThrow
methods.description: Waits for the connection to be established within a timeout, throwing an assertion error if it fails.

methods.name: shutdownHarness
methods.description: Cleans up and disconnects the test harness and shuts down the mock server.

methods.name: runInvokeScenario
methods.description: Simulates a full invoke request lifecycle, including WebSocket message handling and response, returning request and result details.

methods.name: connectResponseFrame
methods.description: Constructs a JSON string for WebSocket response frames with optional parameters.

methods.name: startGatewayServer
methods.description: Sets up a mock WebSocket server with custom handling for handshake and request frames for testing.
